en: GrievEase is a modern, self-hosted society governance platform that ensures resident complaints get resolved with strict turnaround SLAs. Residents report issues with photo proof or file sensitive matters anonymously, track progress through 4 automated escalation levels, and manage cash maintenance payments with immutable audit receipts — all with zero third-party tracking.
